scope: Source/build controls, six asset-backed native fixtures, 42 genuine native pickup/shot arms, three current-engine PassiveReplayScene readers, and 15 scoped current rendered comparisons/native name retirements. No performance/UDP/driver-residency acceptance.
bulkPolicy: Only complete source tree and retail asset manifest objects are replaced by exact canonical hashes/counts. All other structured fields are retained; private path prefixes use role aliases. All 42 scalar arm JSON files are verbatim original bytes. Two logs with original trailing spaces use lossless JSON string envelopes; decode UTF-8 text exactly, including those spaces, and verify decoded SHA/bytes.
